descriptions.en:
## Usage notes

Before you release a pay-as-you-go dedicated host, make sure that no ECS instances are deployed on the dedicated host.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs release-dedicated-host --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dedicated-host-id dh-bp199lyny9b30000 --terminate-subscription false --region cn-hangzhou
